entries.reason: Not a DynamoDB attribute: a field of the confirmed-import ARCHIVE object written to S3 (raw/manual_import/...), kept for whoever reads the raw data lake.
Audit trail on an archived, tombstoned memory: which memory won the merge (the memory event journal records the same); read by an operator in the table.
Dedupe marker row in voc-watermarks: only its existence (and ttl) is checked; the timestamp is for an operator reading the table.
Audit timestamp on the one-off agent seed marker; only `state` drives behaviour.
Audit timestamp next to seeded_prfaq_job_id (which is read): when a decision seeded its PR/FAQ job.
Version provenance (which document a restore was edited from), stored with restored_from_id/_version for the version history audit.
Audit timestamp on a superseded revision snapshot (saved_at is served; replaced_at records when it stopped being current).
Operator diagnostic: the aws_request_id holding a job's execution lease, matched against CloudWatch logs when a job is stuck.
Audit trail on a turned-off review link (the row is kept with revoked = true): who turned it off, for an operator reading the table.
A run's end time on its META row in voc-engineering, beside started_at: the run reports (another track's, not yet in this tree) read the pair off the row.
A key of a session's free-form inspect map (not an item attribute of its own): the run monitor shows the map as it is, so no code names its keys.
